# Post 1: results (RESULTS-P1)

Written by `python -m drone_study.boundary.writer` from the stored Prove rows. N1 to N10 and no other number (spec §20.3, point 11).
In simulation, with the limits of §17.1: this drone model, this air model, this trajectory and these gusts. Descriptive only (§20.2).

## Run

Prove: poisson-prove 0.1.2
Zone B salt: 9c3d4a1e317d59fa
Anchor salt: 644f7723497d4cae
Zone B: 16 directions, 11 speeds from 2 to 16 m/s, timings 0 and 0.125, case fig8-faster, 24 episodes a cell; episodes read: 168960
Anchor: 16 cells, 16 episodes a cell; episodes read: 5120
Flyers: 16 π0 (1, 3, 4, 5, 7, 8, 9, 11, 12, 13, 14, 16, 18, 19, 20, 21) and the cascaded PID, the geometric controller, the wind-only reference and the feasibility oracle
Grid top: 16 m/s
